description: This Kotlin source file defines the LocationCaptureManager class, which manages location data retrieval using Android's LocationManager. It handles permission checks, fetches last known locations, requests current location with timeout handling, and formats location data into a JSON payload.

classes.name: LocationCaptureManager
classes.description: Manages location fetching, including permission checks, last known location retrieval, current location requests with timeout, and data formatting into JSON.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a location, either from cache or by requesting current location, and returns it as a JSON payload.

methods.name: bestLastKnown
methods.description: Finds the most recent last known location within the specified maximum age, ensuring permission is granted.

methods.name: requestCurrent
methods.description: Requests an up-to-date current location with a specified timeout, handling permission checks and provider availability.
